# Courier Prime — vendored (2026-08-14, Jon's ruling)

Native view's courier-class face. Bundled because Courier New (the only
Courier shipping on modern macOS) renders too pale beside the engine
PDF's stem-darkened Courier; Courier Prime is the purpose-built heavier
Courier replacement, metric-compatible at 10-pitch.

- Source: https://github.com/quoteunquoteapps/CourierPrime (master, fonts/ttf)
- License: SIL OFL 1.1 (OFL.txt here) — bundling/redistribution permitted
- Four styles: Regular / Bold / Italic / BoldItalic
- Downloaded + checksummed on the maintainer's dev host by Athena (sha256 prefixes:
  Regular 72f79337, Bold ff1f3878, Italic f1b9a582, BoldItalic 3355273f)
